# SpecWeave

> SpecWeave is an open-source CLI (npm package `specweave`, MIT) that keeps AI coding work in git as one short spec.md per piece of work, an append-only task ledger and a handoff. When Claude Code, Codex or another agent hits a usage limit, `specweave handoff` records the state and pushes the uncommitted edits, and `specweave pickup` continues it in Codex, Grok Build, Gemini CLI, Cursor, Copilot or a second account of the same tool. One AGENTS.md of about 760 tokens is the instruction file every agent reads.

Install: `npm install -g specweave`, then `specweave init` in a repository.

## Start here

- [What is SpecWeave?](https://spec-weave.com/docs/overview/introduction/): the spec, the ledger and the handoff in one page
- [How it works](https://spec-weave.com/docs/overview/how-it-works/): the daily loop from spec to closed increment
- [Installation](https://spec-weave.com/docs/getting-started/installation/): install, update, uninstall
- [Your first increment](https://spec-weave.com/docs/getting-started/first-increment/)

## Switching tools and accounts

- [Handoff and pickup](https://spec-weave.com/docs/guides/cross-tool-handoff/): continue a task in another tool when a usage limit hits, including auto-handoff at 90 percent
- [Claude Code Projects and threads](https://spec-weave.com/docs/guides/claude-code-projects/): one thread is one increment
- [Codex, Grok Build, Cursor and Gemini CLI](https://spec-weave.com/docs/integrations/generic-ai-tools/): what each tool reads
- [Auto-handoff rules](https://spec-weave.com/docs/guides/auto-handoff/): when SpecWeave hands off by itself at 90 percent of a Claude Code or Codex usage window, and the local checkpoints it saves between turns
- [Switch from Claude Code to Codex without losing your place](https://spec-weave.com/docs/guides/switch-claude-code-to-codex/): the two commands, what carries over, and switching back
- [Claude Code usage limit reached: what to do next](https://spec-weave.com/docs/guides/claude-code-usage-limit/): how the five-hour and weekly limits work and every way to keep going
- [Claude Code vs Codex](https://spec-weave.com/docs/guides/claude-code-vs-codex/): differences that matter day to day, and switching when a limit hits
- [AGENTS.md vs CLAUDE.md](https://spec-weave.com/docs/guides/agents-md-vs-claude-md/): one instruction file for every coding agent
- [SpecWeave 3.0](https://spec-weave.com/docs/guides/specweave-3/): what changed from 2.x and how to upgrade

## Teams

- [Pricing for teams](https://spec-weave.com/pricing/): SpecWeave is free (MIT); private skills on Verified Skill from $20 a month; a $990 founding team pilot that sets up handoff between Claude Code and Codex
